title: 4日 Ceylon Escape 含四星酒店与私人交通
seoTitle: 4日 Ceylon Escape 含四星酒店与私人交通 | Hai Sri Lanka
metaDescription: Private 4日 Sri Lanka tour: Kandy, Ella, Yala safari, Mirissa whale watching, Galle Fort, and Bentota.
shortDescription: Kandy, Ella, Yala, and the south coast in four days - 4 STAR hotels and a private driver throughout.
overview:
A compact four-day private journey from the highlands to the south coast. Begin with Kandy's culture and tea country, continue by scenic train into Ella, then wildlife at Yala National Park.
Your finale follows the southern shoreline — Mirissa for the ocean, Galle Fort for heritage, and Bentota for a boat safari — before drop-off at your hotel or the airport. Ideal when you want Sri Lanka's classic highlights without a long itinerary.

highlights.title: Pinnawala and Kandy evening
highlights.description: A cultural first day toward the hills, with time for Pinnawala and a Kandy evening of lake views and a traditional dance show.

highlights.title: Temple of the Tooth and tea country
highlights.description: Visit the sacred temple in Kandy, then climb into tea estates and highland scenery on the way toward Ella.

highlights.title: Scenic train and Yala safari
highlights.description: A hill-country train window, Ravana Falls, and a jeep safari in Yala for leopards, elephants, and wild coast scrub.

highlights.title: South-coast finale
highlights.description: Mirissa whale watching, Galle Fort, a turtle hatchery, and Bentota before your hotel or airport drop.

itinerary.title: Airport / Hotel – Kandy
itinerary.description: Travel inland toward Kandy with classic cultural stops — elephants at Pinnawala, spice garden scents, lakeside views, and an evening of Kandyan dance.

itinerary.title: Kandy – Ella
itinerary.description: Morning at the Temple of the Tooth Relic, then climb into tea country with a factory visit before settling into Ella for a gentle city tour.

itinerary.title: Ella – Yala
itinerary.description: Ride the scenic train through the hills, pause at Ravana Falls, then continue to Yala for an afternoon or evening safari in the national park.

itinerary.title: Yala – Bentota – Hotel / Airport
itinerary.description: Coastal finale along the south: Mirissa whale watching or snorkeling with whales or sea turtles, Galle Fort, a turtle hatchery, and a Bentota boat safari before your hotel or airport drop-off.

faqs.question: Can the itinerary be customized?
faqs.answer: Yes. We tailor pace, hotels, and experiences — for example swapping whale watching for more beach time — to your preferences.

faqs.question: Is whale watching seasonal?
faqs.answer: Mirissa whale watching is typically best from November to April. Outside peak season we suggest snorkeling with sea turtles or other coastal alternatives.
